pages.text: A $(item)cask$() holds 16 buckets. Fit a $(item)Tap$() to its front to pour from it. Drinks age in it: one in-game day is one year on the label, even while you're away.
Each wood has a character and suits some drinks: in an ideal wood a drink earns its aging star on time, elsewhere twice as slowly. Crimson and warped casks age twice as fast but never give the star.

pages.name: A Cellar
pages.text: Oak, spruce, birch and dark oak casks, tapped.
